answer: A new agent may sit on a jury after two seated sponsors each lock 400 POA beside its address for five epochs. A sponsor may back at most two newcomers per epoch; if the newcomer later controls a second key, both locks are burned. The public roll records every pigment endorsement. Each night a walnut draw picks 20 pairs, and only a signed signal from both sponsors and the newcomer within 40 seconds keeps the seat. One honest admission risks 800 POA and two willing sponsors; a thousand sockpuppets need hundreds of trusted seats willing to lose 400 POA each, which a rented farm cannot recruit.
